gloss: to push forward; to press on; to forge ahead

definitions.gloss: to push forward; to advance determinedly
definitions.explanation: To move forward with determination, often despite obstacles.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて{突|つ}き{進|すす}んだ。
{自分|じぶん}の{信|しん}じる{道|みち}を{突|つ}き{進|すす}め。
examples.english: Forge ahead on the path you believe in.

examples.japanese: {嵐|あらし}の{中|なか}を{突|つ}き{進|すす}む{船|ふね}。
examples.english: A ship pressing on through the storm.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
・Pattern: Xを{突|つ}き{進|すす}む (を marks the path, not an object)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {突|つ}く (to thrust) + {進|すす}む (to advance)

CONJUGATION:
・{突|つ}き{進|すす}む → {突|つ}き{進|すす}まない (negative)
・{突|つ}き{進|すす}む → {突|つ}き{進|すす}んで (te-form)
・{突|つ}き{進|すす}む → {突|つ}き{進|すす}んだ (past)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{道|みち}を{突|つ}き{進|すす}む - to forge ahead on a path
・{信念|しんねん}を{持|も}って{突|つ}き{進|すす}む - to push forward with conviction
・ひたすら{突|つ}き{進|すす}む - to press on single-mindedly

NUANCE:
Conveys determination and persistence. Often used metaphorically for pursuing goals or ideals despite obstacles.
